description: This file defines the EmployeePersonalDetailController class within the OrangeHRM project. It manages the display and permissions for employee personal details, including loading nationality data and configuring the front-end component with relevant properties based on configuration and employee data.

classes.name: EmployeePersonalDetailController
classes.description: Controller class managing the employee personal details view, including data setup, permissions, and configuration-based UI element toggles.

methods.name: getNationalityService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of NationalityService to fetch nationality data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the data and components for rendering the personal details view, setting properties and permissions based on employee data and configuration.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns the data groups required for capability checks related to personal information.
